title: TEST FIXTURE: Automatic Emergency Braking
text:
## Automatic Emergency Braking
Automatic emergency braking uses forward-facing sensors such as cameras or radar to detect a vehicle ahead. If the driver does not respond to a forward collision warning, the system can apply the brakes automatically to avoid a crash or reduce its severity.
## Limitations
Sensors can be affected by weather, dirt and lighting. Drivers must stay attentive and keep their hands on the wheel.
